authority: AI source review is attributed and distinct from domain-expert verification. No human verification or approval is inferred.
decision_basis: Operator requested AI verification with the agent, model and time recorded on 2026-09-05.
scope: Existing corpus and all prepared 2026 candidates. Candidates enter screening only after canonical Work-Version binding.
search_cutoff_basis: Latest completed search package; later additions require a separately recorded targeted search and eligibility decision.
additional_literature_rule: Add only source-verified, bibliographically reconciled literature addressing a concrete evidence gap; retain its search date and unscreened state.
working_data_visibility: The repository is an attributed research working record. The result site is built separately from eligible reviewed artifacts. This policy does not make Git history private.
